spec.hypothesis: Origins with at least 95% unchanged days in the last 60 are the flattest stretches. They are mostly A100_40GB hyperscaler spot origins plus fully flat neocloud A100 origins. In these stretches the rare jump is not covered by the medium band. Always-wide gains 0.0008 on A100_40GB spot (0.01122 vs 0.01206). The cutoff selects a tighter, different set of decisions than the rejected instrument_class and relative_q80 < 0.0001 edits, and it avoids the lower-flatness A100_SXM and H100 origins. The neocloud A100 series lose a little under wide, so the gain is small and uncertain.
